rules.name: Direct Prompt Injection
rules.description: Detection rules for AI-specific attacks: prompt injection, model manipulation, data exfiltration, training data extraction
rules.query: SELECT "siem_ai_llm_attacks_ai_llm_attacks_041", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%direct%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%') AND "value" > 0
